description: This file defines the abstract class GrainTimer and its derived classes, implementing timer functionality within the Orleans runtime. It includes methods for scheduling, invoking callbacks, and managing timer state, as well as internal classes and interfaces related to timer invocation.

classes.name: GrainTimer
classes.description: An abstract class implementing timer functionality for Orleans grains, managing scheduling, callback invocation, and timer lifecycle.

classes.name: GrainTimer<T>
classes.description: A generic subclass of GrainTimer that supports callback functions with state.

classes.name: InterleavingGrainTimer
classes.description: A subclass of GrainTimer that supports interleaved callback execution.

classes.name: IGrainTimerInvoker
classes.description: An internal interface for invoking timer callbacks, used for call filtering and internal invocation.

methods.name: ScheduleTickOnActivation
methods.description: Schedules a message to invoke the timer callback upon activation.

methods.name: InvokeCallbackAsync
methods.description: Abstract method to invoke the timer callback asynchronously, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: InvokeGrainTimerCallbackAsync
methods.description: Handles invocation of the timer callback, managing synchronous/asynchronous completion and exception handling.

methods.name: OnTickCompleted
methods.description: Prepares the timer for the next tick after the current callback completes.

methods.name: OnCallbackException
methods.description: Logs and creates a response for exceptions thrown during callback invocation.

methods.name: AwaitCallbackTask
methods.description: Awaits the task returned by the callback, handling exceptions and finalizing the tick.

methods.name: Change
methods.description: Reschedules the timer with new due time and period.

methods.name: ValidateArguments
methods.description: Validates the due time and period arguments for timer scheduling.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Cancels and disposes of the timer, and notifies the registry.
